Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the conversation today. Great to hear more about FinPath's roadmap for automated KYC and the need to keep inference latency under 200ms for live scoring.

Next steps I suggest:
- 60-minute product demo + architecture deep-dive (we'll cover batching, KV caching, and private deployment options)
- Security / procurement sync (SOC 2 and data residency questions)

Can you do any of these windows next week (PST)?
- Tue 2026-09-22 09:00–10:00
- Tue 2026-09-22 13:00–14:00
- Thu 2026-09-24 11:00–12:00

Looping in Sean (platform) and Dev (security) to join the deep-dive and answer technical questions — I've attached a one-page mutual action plan and our SOC 2 overview for procurement.

If those times don't work, feel free to pick something on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/marissa-cole/redwood-demo

Thanks,
